resources.string: These faces appear to belong to the same person. Enter a name to confirm.
A person named "%1$s" already exists. Merge into the existing person?
Controls how faces are grouped into persons. Lower thresholds mean stricter matching.
Cosine distance below which two faces are linked in clustering.
Cosine distance below which a whole cluster is assigned to an existing person.
Cosine distance below which a single face is assigned to an existing person (pre-clustering step).
Clusters smaller than this size are ignored (not shown as suggestions).
Weights trained by InsightFace on a research-only dataset. The code is open, but the weights restrict use.
Both code and weights are Apache-2.0 (OpenCV Zoo). Free for any purpose, including commercial.
Weights trained by InsightFace on WebFace600K, a research-only dataset. The code is open, but the weights restrict use.
Both code and weights are Apache-2.0 (OpenCV). Free for any purpose, including commercial.
For non-commercial research use only. Choose this model only if that license fits your purpose.
Which model locates faces in your photos.
Higher accuracy, but non-commercial research use only.
Apache-2.0 licensed, pairs with SFace. Lighter and fast.

Existing faces stay valid — Eidora reuses faces it already found (including those from XMP). You can keep them and use the new model only for future scans, or re-scan every photo now (takes a while; the new model may download first). Names are kept either way.
Which model matches faces to the same person.
Higher accuracy, but non-commercial research use only.
Apache-2.0 licensed, works with YuNet. Slightly lower accuracy.
Switching the model recomputes every face embedding from scratch. Your confirmed names are kept, but grouping is rebuilt and this takes a while. The new model may need to be downloaded first.
Pause processing when the device gets too hot or the battery gets too low.
Processing pauses when battery is below this level.
Processing pauses when battery temperature exceeds this value.
Could not download the face recognition model after several attempts. Check for an app update or your network connection.
How strongly the time between photos influences clustering. 0 = ignore time, 1 = default (half-life 3 years), 2 = strong influence. Helps separate siblings and track ageing.
This face will be permanently deleted and will not be detected again during the next sync. Use this to remove false positive detections.
All unnamed suggestions will be deleted. The faces will move back to Unknown. This cannot be undone.
"%1$s" will be deleted. All faces will be moved back to Unknown and the XMP metadata will be reset. This cannot be undone.
All face detections, embeddings and clustering results will be deleted and recalculated from scratch. XMP metadata will be cleared. This may take a long time. Continue?
Photo no longer exists on this device
Higher = more faces linked per cluster (looser grouping, risk of mixing persons). Lower = only very similar faces linked (tighter clusters, more suggestions).
Higher = clusters are assigned to existing persons more easily (fewer new suggestions). Lower = only very similar clusters are merged with a person.
Higher = single faces are assigned to existing persons more easily. Lower = only very close matches are assigned (more faces land in Unknown).
Higher = only large groups become suggestions (fewer but more reliable). Lower = even small groups of faces become suggestions.

Controls how strongly time influences matching. Higher = temporally close photos of a person are preferred for matching, and photos far apart are less likely to be linked (helps with siblings and ageing). Set to 0 to ignore time completely.
Select which folders are included in the sync. Only checked folders will be analysed. Only the Camera folder is selected by default.
All faces that have not been explicitly confirmed will be removed from this person and moved back to Unknown. Confirmed faces remain.
Remove unconfirmed faces from persons first
Eidora detects and groups faces in your photos — entirely on your device, without any cloud. To do this it needs access to your photos.
Required to read and analyse your photos.
Required to write recognised names back into your photo files (XMP metadata), compatible with DigiKam and Aves.
Controls whether manual operations mark faces as confirmed (name written into the photo) or leave them as unconfirmed suggestions.
When you assign a face to a person, mark it as confirmed.
When you give a suggestion a name, also confirm all of its faces.
When you merge a suggestion into an existing person, confirm the merged faces.
Eidora needs two ML models for face detection and recognition. They are downloaded once from the Eidora GitHub releases and stored on your device. All processing stays local.
Face detection: finds faces and their key points in your photos
Face recognition: computes a compact signature per face so the same person can be grouped
The models for this app version are no longer available for download. A newer version of Eidora is probably available – please update the app.
Permanently removes photos, faces and persons from folders that are no longer selected.
Select which photo folders Eidora should analyse. You can change this later in the settings.
A person named \"%1$s\" is already visible. Choose which one to merge into, or cancel to keep them separate.
Local, on-device face recognition for your photos.
Eidora is free software under the GPLv3.
ML models: InsightFace, non-commercial research use only.
Processing only continues once the battery has charged back to this level. Keep it above the pause value so charging makes real progress before work resumes.
Processing only continues once the battery has cooled to this value. Keep it below the pause value so the device cools down properly instead of pausing again immediately.
Save a diagnostic log file for bug reports
How far back should the log go? Android keeps only a limited buffer, so older entries may no longer be available. Only Eidora\'s own log entries are exported.
